description.value: HUB Co. Brewing is a craft brewery with an expansive tasting room situated on the historic North Railway Avenue in downtown Mission, BC. The venue pours its own house-brewed beers alongside a food menu, and regularly hosts community events including trivia nights, gaming evenings, and creative workshops. Cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor will find it a lively local gathering spot with a distinctly neighbourhood feel.
